*Guide validation:* Data strongly reinforces Card 439's proposed rows for *Porting reference* (Cursor Codex mid-tier) and *Fix-round review* (Claude Opus strong tier).

Keep all roles. No mid-card additions occurred; the task force was appropriately sized for this high-risk scanner increment.
